* wolf steps from behind a pine with a rustle, offers a shallow, courtly bow, and says he hopes he has not startled red before smoothly asking where such a dutiful girl walks alone with a basket that smells so sweet <0.09>  
* red startles, clutching her basket to her chest, then relaxes when wolf compliments her red hood and calls her “kind granddaughter,” prompting her to explain she is hurrying to grandmother’s cottage along the safe path <0.08>  
* wolf pads along beside the edge of the path, never quite stepping onto it, pretending to peer anxiously into the darker trees as he wonders aloud if red is quite certain this path leads most quickly to grandmother’s door <0.08>  
* red, eager to prove she knows what she’s doing, names grandmother and mentions the little cottage with blue shutters, giving wolf landmark details without realizing she has drawn a map with her tongue <0.07>  
* wolf repeats grandmother’s name back to red in a purring tone, assures her he only worries for an old woman left waiting, and inquires how far the cottage is and whether red has ever wished the walk might be shorter on such a heavy-armed day <0.06>
